transaction: canonical transaction_version=2, same context hash, exact component/path/bytes/SHA256 facts
serialization: final manifest v1 and artifact facts remain byte-identical for the same context and complete outputs
lifecycle: create a new private initialized state v2 stage with durable incomplete marker
acquire exclusive OS writer lock; no recovery while another writer owns it
put: durable transaction -> complete artifact -> durable canonical receipt -> remove transaction and sync state directory
finish_component: complete producer result -> rehash component -> durable seal
finish: all selected seals -> complete hashes/closure -> durable canonical manifest -> remove incomplete marker and sync root
required_preflight: explicit caller-expected build/locale/component/source/plan/producer identities exactly match stored canonical context and protocol
incomplete marker has exact canonical contents; completed markerless stages refuse write access
all committed receipts, payloads and optional seals are canonical and complete
a pending artifact reserves full declared file/byte/metadata limits before mutation
every pending/final link pair is the same inode with exactly two links; unrelated links refuse
complete observed namespace contains only declared payloads and explicitly identified producer-owned pending files
no filesystem mutation before complete preflight and namespace closure
recovery_actions: discard only recognized unpublished regular single-link pending files within declared lengths; never trust their partial bytes
unlink only a matching two-link pending/final publication pair; retain and rehash complete final bytes
authenticate a final artifact against its durable transaction and write a missing canonical receipt
remove resolved transaction only after receipt publication; retain unresolved transaction for exact producer replay
discard unpublished seal; require new producer completion; retain verified published seal
discard partial unpublished manifest; regenerate only after every seal; reuse an exact published manifest without rewriting
producer_replay: Replay unfinished producers to their full complete result. Every retained unsealed artifact and outstanding intent must be re-emitted with identical facts before its component can seal; duplicate callbacks cannot cover a different retained file. Identical retained artifacts return AlreadyPresent. An outstanding transaction requires the same exact expected bytes; conflicting output poisons the active run. completed_components exposes verified seals for skipping fully completed producers. Unfinished computation is replayed; no arbitrary per-task computational checkpoint or source inventory discovery is supplied.
failed_recovery: Preflight rejection preserves stage bytes and names. Later I/O/interruption can leave applied safe recovery steps; marker remains and a subsequent explicit same-context resume repeats validation. No atomic hostile-mutation or filesystem power-loss guarantee.
legacy: Existing complete manifest/state v1 packages remain read-only verifiable. Incomplete v1 stages lack a durable intent protocol and are not migrated or resumed. Interrupted initial create before durable context/protocol/lock initialization is not admitted.
limits: Same downward-only v1 payload/manifest/metadata limits. At most 24 recovery observations plus matching cleanup records fit the fixed scratch allowance. A sorted digest/component/seen index for retained unsealed artifacts charges actual Vec capacity in addition to the fact inventory before mutation; later inventories subtract that reservation. It is released after complete replay coverage. No unbounded journal history or portable RSS guarantee.
excluded: semantic or new runtime compatibility acceptance
authentication and atomic adversarial filesystem snapshot
